subject: Demo: Dedicated/Private deployment security review and regional stakeholders
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Andrew Parker <andrew.parker@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo request - Dedicated/Private deployment

Hi Andrew —

Thanks for the request. We'd love to run a focused demo that covers Dedicated and Private deployment options and loop in the regional security reviewers you mentioned.

Quick ask: can you share which stakeholders from Acme will need to join? You mentioned EU and APAC reviewers — can you confirm names and timezones so we can propose slots that work across US/EU/APAC?

Proposed windows (all converted to your PST):
- Thu 26 Feb, 9:00–10:00 PST (Fri 27 Feb 17:00–18:00 CET / Sat 27 Feb 01:00 JST) — ok for US+EU but rough for APAC
- Fri 27 Feb, 07:00–08:00 PST (Fri 27 Feb 15:00–16:00 CET / Sat 27 Feb 23:00 JST) — earlier for US, late for APAC
- Mon 2 Mar, 11:00–12:00 PST (Mon 2 Mar 19:00–20:00 CET / Tue 3 Mar 03:00 JST) — possible if APAC can join late

Note: daylight savings in US starts 2026-03-08; EU changes later in March — I'll call out DST explicitly if we schedule around those dates.

I'll loop in Marcus (SE) to present architecture and our security leads so they can answer deployment / data handling questions.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: redwood-security-brief.pdf (high-level), acme-dataroom-request-list.xlsx (template)
From: Andrew Parker <andrew.parker@acmehealth.com>

Subject: Re: Demo request - Dedicated/Private deployment

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the quick reply. Sorry for the vagueness earlier: attendees will be:
- Me (Andrew Parker, US, PST)
- Sylvie Dupont (EU, CET) — EU DPO will also want to join if available
- Keiko Tanaka (APAC, JST) — APAC security lead will join if we can find a reasonable local time
- Procurement (procurement@acmehealth.com) for any contract/terms questions

From the windows you proposed, the Fri 27 Feb 07:00–08:00 PST looks best for the core team (that's 15:00 CET / 23:00 JST). Keiko says she can make 23:00 JST if it's a one-off, but would prefer earlier on her side if possible.

Also: small ask — can Redwood include regional data handling notes specifically for EU data residency and APAC transfer controls? Sylvie will want to review those prior to the security call.

Thanks,
Andrew

Director of IT Procurement, Acme Health

Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Demo request - Dedicated/Private deployment

Great — thanks for the attendee list. I'm looping in Marcus (SE) to drive the demo and Vivek for commercial/contract questions.

Marcus/Vivek — please confirm availability for Fri 27 Feb, 07:00–08:00 PST (Fri 27 Feb 15:00–16:00 CET / Fri 27 Feb 23:00 JST). Note the JST time is late; if Keiko prefers, we can swap to Mon 2 Mar 11:00–12:00 PST (Mon 19:00–20:00 CET / Tue 03:00 JST) but that's even later for JST.

Also looping in our regional reviewers: Soojin Lee (EU privacy/DPO) and Neha Kapoor (APAC security lead) to confirm they can join and to pre-share the regional items Sylvie/Keiko asked for.

Sooj, Neha — key asks from Acme:
- EU data residency options and data access controls (Sylvie)
- Cross-border transfer controls and contractual safeguards
- APAC controls around logging, audit access, and local incident response processes

I've attached a short security brief and our dataroom template. Marcus will prep the demo to highlight Dedicated/Private network/topology and our audit trail capabilities.

Thanks all — please reply with availability or any blocking questions.

Best,
Laura
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Hi team —

I can join Fri 27 Feb 15:00–16:00 CET (which lines up with the 07:00 PST slot). That works for me. A couple of notes from EU side that I can cover during the call:
- We'll need to validate data residency options in the contract (region-specific), and confirm that logs/audit exports are available to Acme's DPO team.
- Please provide a one-page summary of encryption at rest/key management and an outline of subprocessor list for EU processors.

Laura/Marcus — happy to review the brief and we can add a short slide for the contract options. Also, small FYI: EU will switch DST on 2026-03-29, so no immediate DST conflict for these dates, but good to call out if we push into late March.

Soojin
